name: Klein Detail Slider
description: A simple detail LoRA slider that increases the details in an image. Works very well in I2I to increase the details of a blurred or low resolution photo. See the sample with the woman, left is a T2I 256x256 image, right is a 1024x1024 I2I generated with this LoRA, no prompt. The samples weights range from -10 to 10 but it can easily be pushed past that. Hope you like it.
